dialogues.text: Welcome to my shop! I sell all sorts of useful items for adventurers.

options.text: What do you have for sale?

dialogues.text: I've got bronze weapons, tools for woodcutting and mining, and some basic supplies. Unfortunately, my stock system isn't quite ready yet, so you'll have to come back later for actual trading!

options.text: When will the shop be ready?

dialogues.text: Aye, I'll buy certain items from you - especially ones that are in good condition. But you'll need to wait until the trading system is implemented!
The developers are working on it! Should be ready in a future update. For now, you can find items on the ground or from defeating creatures.
